notes: Thompson's 'bony fish' and generic 'fishes' (otoliths, scales, lens, colour patterns) are resolved to the ray-finned fishes, Actinopterygii; GBIF has no Teleostei or Osteichthyes taxon. Elasmobranchs are listed separately. No accepted Actinopterygii taxon exists in the GBIF backbone (the backbone currently has no class between Chordata and the ray-finned orders), so gbif_usage_key is null and no GBIF occurrence count was built.
